project.description: How well an observer could see a thing, as a number that changes smoothly: its sharpness first, the share of the thing's detail the observer could make out as it and the thing now move, from all of it standing still to next to none of it streaking past. The engine says the number and knows nothing of pictures; whatever draws takes it, with how much one of its own pixels covers, to how finely the thing need be drawn. Whether anything stands between the two is not this: that is asked of what is drawn.
